## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `sap-jco-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Register a program ID for inbound connections

1. <!-- manual: Open transaction SM59 in SAP GUI -->
2. <!-- manual: Create a new RFC destination of type T (TCP/IP Connection) -->
3. <!-- manual: Set the Program ID to a unique identifier (e.g., BALLERINA_SERVER) -->
4. Set **Activation Type** to **Registered Server Program**
5. <!-- manual: On the Technical Settings tab, enter the SAP gateway host and service (e.g., sapgw00) -->
6. <!-- manual: Save and test the connection -->

## Step 3: Configure IDoc partner profile

1. <!-- manual: Open transaction WE20 to create or edit a partner profile -->
2. <!-- manual: Add an outbound parameter for the relevant IDoc message type -->
3. <!-- manual: Set the port to point to the RFC destination created in SM59 -->
4. <!-- manual: Open transaction WE21 to verify the port configuration uses your RFC destination -->
